# Dylan Theriot

> Dylan Theriot is a senior product engineer in San Francisco, CA: Founding Engineer at Loot Labs Inc. (boxed.gg) since Apr 2024, previously a Software Engineer at Netflix. B.S. Honors Computer Science, Texas A&M University.

## Experience

- **Founding Engineer, Loot Labs Inc. ([boxed.gg](https://boxed.gg)), Apr 2024 to present.** Architected the core frontend for an app supporting 500K+ users. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, SST/AWS, Stripe.
- **Software Engineer, Netflix ([netflix.com](https://netflix.com)), Aug 2022 to Apr 2024.** Modernized Backlot, an asset fulfillment platform, and led DeliveryUI (3M+ assets per year). Stack: React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Java.
- Software Engineer Intern, Software.com ([software.com](https://www.software.com)), Aug to Dec 2021
- Engineering Fellow, 8VC ([8vc.com](https://8vc.com)), Jun to Aug 2021
- Software Engineer Intern, Twitch ([twitch.tv](https://twitch.tv)), May to Aug 2021
- Undergraduate Research Assistant, Texas A&M University ([tamu.edu](https://www.tamu.edu)), Feb 2020 to May 2021
- Software Engineer Intern, Chick-fil-A ([chick-fil-a.com](https://www.chick-fil-a.com)), Jun to Jul 2020
- Software Developer Intern, HCSS ([hcss.com](https://www.hcss.com)), May to Aug 2019
